method: Single cold+warm lab samples per route/device. Fresh browser context per pair, routing blocks non-GET and off-origin requests. Routing disables HTTP cache, so warm means connection/process/session reuse, not browser-cache validation. Mobile emulates constrained network/4xCPU; no claim of real-user INP or p75 Core Web Vitals. Main backend only anonymously read; no auth or financial actions.
